# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 1
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 1-2 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 1

---

[Pages 1-6 of the manuscript are lost. The text begins mid-conversation in chapter 5. Chapters 1-4 are entirely absent from the Coptic manuscript. The original opening of the Gospel of Mary is unrecoverable.]

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* All three translating agents (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) are in full agreement: nothing can be translated here. The missing pages are a manuscript reality, not a lacuna within a surviving text. The consensus translation for chapters 1-4 is the honest acknowledgment of their absence. The reader begins at chapter 5.
